goal.hit.text: Target reached. That deserves a hazelnut. I ate it. Sorry.
{target} words. Target reached. I was awake for it, mostly.
Target reached. I'd do a little dance, but I've just woken up…
Target met. I've put a hazelnut aside for you. It's mostly whole.

goal.progress.text: {pct}% of the target. I've been counting. Counting makes me sleepy…
{pct}% there. That's more than I do all year. I hibernate.
{count} words. A lot for a dormouse to count before his nap.

snapshot.saved.text: Snapshot saved. Wrapped in a leaf, like my winter nuts.
Saved. A little copy, curled up safe. Like me, but less sleepy.

app.failed.text: Something didn't go through. I'm awake now. Worth a look.
Oh. Something went wrong just now. Have a look when you can.
That didn't work. I'd help, but paws…

session.long.text: {minutes} minutes. I napped through most of them. Sorry…
A long session. I've had three naps and a snack.
{minutes} minutes. For a dormouse, that's a whole day. Mostly sleep…
Midnight. I'd be asleep, but I'm always asleep.

stuck.offer.text: Synonyms are a right-click away. I keep mine under my pillow.
Click me if you want to talk. I'll stay awake. I'll try…
I can stay quiet. It's my best skill. Or click me and we'll chat.

pause.long.text: Oh, a pause. I'll just rest my eyes for a mo…
I'm counting hazelnuts. One… two… zzz…
{remaining} words to the target. They'll keep. Like nuts in a burrow…

writer.returning.text: Oh, hello. I've been curled up in “{doc}”. It's very cosy.
{words} words, all where you left them. I slept on them. Gently.
Hello. Everything's where you left it. I didn't move either. I never do.

offer.snapshot.text: A long bit of revising. Shall I save a snapshot? I'd write it all down myself, but I'd fall asleep halfway…
No snapshot yet. I can save one. It's like hiding a hazelnut, except I'll remember where this one is.
Before the next change, a snapshot, if you like. I'm awake for it. Just about.

offer.bible.text: {title} again. I'd learn it by heart for you, but I'd sleep through it. Shall I look it up instead?

{title}, {count} visits. I woke up specially to count them. Shall I look it up?
